newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BATISTUTA MAY TURN TO REAL MADRID, PAPER SAYS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BATISTUTA MAY TURN TO REAL MADRID, PAPER SAYS.

text.p: Argentine international striker Gabriel Batistuta will turn to Real Madrid if Barcelona do not improve their offer, a Spanish newspaper said on Wednesday.
"I'm going to play in Spain, that's for sure," Batistuta, who plays for Italian club Fiorentina, was quoted as saying in the Spanish sports daily AS.
"I want to return to Spanish football but if Barcelona do not decide before Thursday then I will start negotiations with Madrid."
Fiorentina want 3.5 billion pesetas ($23.8 million) for the player but Barcelona have offered only 2.7 billion pesetas ($18.4 million).
Batistuta has been seen by Barcelona as a possible replacement for departing Brazilian marksman Ronaldo.
But Monaco's Brazilian striker Sonny Anderson is also a target for the Catalan club.
"We are negotiating with both Batistuta and Anderson, although we need to sign only one of these two," Barcelona president Jose Luis Nunez said.
